prompt_contract: Each of the 13 workflow JSON files now contains an n8n AI Agent v3.1 and OpenAI Chat Model v1.2 connected through ai_languageModel. Arabic system prompts are embedded as system messages. The OpenAI credential ID and Webhook Header Auth credential ID are intentionally omitted from Git and are injected from the local n8n credential store by Update-And-Test-SmartNetAgents.ps1. The model receives minimized advisory context only; deterministic Code nodes remain authoritative and no write tools are connected.
